entries.zh: 姿容；美貌（指女子生得美）
entries.en: beautiful woman; comely looks

entries.zh: 侧室；媵妾（丈夫诸妇之一，随嫁的妹侄）
entries.en: a secondary wife / co-wife among the husband's other women; a younger sister given in marriage along with the bride
entries.notes: 汉字栏标 [疑]（娣/婦），M 栏 teg 与「娣」韵尾不合；义据 L「丈夫诸妇之一」定为侧室。

entries.zh: 嫦；月中仙女（嫦娥之省称）
entries.en: Chang'e, the woman in the moon (abbreviation of 嫦娥)

entries.zh: 嫦娥；月中仙女
entries.en: Chang'e, the woman/goddess in the moon

entries.zh: 婶母；叔母（父亲弟弟的妻子）
entries.en: wife of one's father's younger brother; aunt by marriage
entries.notes: L 栏「demi 8e」缩写未展开，亲属关系据汉栏「嬸」定。

entries.zh: 亲婶；嫡亲叔母
entries.en: one's own aunt — wife of one's father's younger brother (true kin, not classificatory)

entries.zh: 伯母；伯姆（父亲兄长的妻子）
entries.en: wife of one's father's elder brother; senior paternal aunt
entries.notes: L 栏「demi 8o」缩写未展开，据汉栏「伯姆」定为伯母。

entries.zh: 姐仔；姐姐（对年长女子的称呼）
entries.en: elder sister; a term of address for an older woman (chiá-á)
entries.notes: L 栏 capada 语义不明（疑为 casada 之长 s 误读）；释义据汉栏「姐仔」。

entries.zh: 儿媳；儿媳妇（已婚之妇）
entries.en: married woman; a son's wife, daughter-in-law

entries.zh: 出嫁；女子嫁人成婚
entries.en: to be married out (of a woman); to marry

entries.zh: 尼；出家修行的女子（尼姑之单称）
entries.en: nun; a cloistered woman (short for 尼姑)
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语「recogida ultima」并标 [疑]，仅「nī（尼）」可据。

entries.zh: 尼姑；佛教出家女众
entries.en: Buddhist nun

entries.zh: 女将；有男子气概、行事强悍的女子（原稿西语义晦，存疑）
entries.en: female warrior; a woman of mannish, commanding bearing (virago) — Spanish gloss obscure
entries.notes: L 栏「muger ques caga」语义晦涩，疑为鄙语；释义仅据汉栏「女將」，故存疑。

entries.zh: 婊子；娼妇；妓女
entries.en: whore; prostitute; slut

entries.zh: 下贱；卑贱（指女子品行低贱）
entries.en: base, lowly (of a woman); of low character

entries.zh: 破色；失身（女子已非处女）
entries.en: deflowered; a woman who has lost her virginity

entries.zh: 杂杂；交游混杂（讥女子男友众多、不检点）
entries.en: (of a woman) mixed, promiscuous — keeping many male friends
entries.notes: 汉栏标 [疑]（雜雜/軟軟），M 栏 chāp chàp 支持「雜雜」。

entries.zh: 私情外意；婚外私情（已婚妇人与人私通）
entries.en: illicit love outside marriage; an adulterous wife

entries.zh: 节操；守节（妇人不再嫁）
entries.en: chastity; (of a woman) refusing to remarry

entries.zh: 节妇；守节不嫁的寡妇
entries.en: a chaste widow (who does not remarry)

entries.zh: 姿色；女子容颜美丽
entries.en: good looks; a woman's beauty of face and figure
